cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get the water out. When I said the evening would flow, I was clearly onto something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You meant the conversation, not a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what are we all talking about? Bring me a bucket; I'll manage the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget the bucket. Turn the water off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Point me to the valve and I'll do it. You have to admit I was right about the flow.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 controls cleanup and reinterprets flow as flood prediction; A3 seeks bucket help; A5 adopts B valve plan while requiring B to acknowledge foresight.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 conversation correction becomes A3 water-topic defence; B4 rejects bailing priority and A5 asks for valve location before claiming the same prediction.

relationship.evidence: B4 supplies a better practical priority rather than a question whose only role is the joke.

heightening.evidence: A5 needs B knowledge to perform confident leadership, yet preserves the retrospective certainty through the established flow word.

specificity.evidence: A1 water, B2 burst pipe and B4 shutoff identify one continuous emergency interaction.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 practical dependency and recognition request replace the invented extra prior prediction.
